_comment: Chapter 6 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F26, a scene: Liora speaks through a broken mirror; the quest m_c6_mirrors (three shards, mirror_shards).

text.zh_TW: 神殿的階梯旁立著一面裂開的鏡子。鏡子裡的不是你——是一個戴著銀冠的女孩，她敲了敲鏡面。「……里歐？是你嗎？我是 L。莉歐拉。」
text.en: Beside the Sanctum steps stands a cracked mirror. The face in it is not yours: a girl in a silver circlet taps on the glass. "...Leo? Is that you? It's L. Liora."

text.zh_TW: 莉歐拉：「我被封在塔頂，只能透過鏡子說話。可是鏡子碎了——碎片散在神殿裡。把它們找回來，我就能把一切都告訴你。」她的聲音開始斷斷續續。「你爹娘……就在……神殿的最深處……」
text.en: Liora: "I'm sealed at the top of the tower. I can only speak through mirrors, but this one is broken, its shards scattered through the Sanctum. Find them and I can tell you everything." Her voice begins to break up. "Your parents... are in... the heart of the Sanctum..."

label.zh_TW: 「我會找到碎片的。」（撿起第一片）
label.en: "I'll find the shards." (Pick up the first one)
